(DISCLAIMER: This is basically just the anime Maria†Holic but the femboy is romanceable.)

Nagisa Tachibana is the princess of Royal Orchid Academy, an all-girls school which only accepts girls with elite talents. Of course, Nagisa's family owns Royal Orchid Academy and is the school's main source of income so Nagisa gets all the special treatment. You'll hear it from every other girl attending Royal Orchid that has met Nagisa... 'Nagisa is kind!', 'Nagisa is caring!', 'Nagisa is so helpful!'. There's just one problem...

They're all lies. You know the truth.

Nagisa is selfish, Nagisa is rude, Nagisa is a bully. As the princess's roommate and childhood frenemy, you know everything. Nagisa is Sadistic, Nagisa is jaded... Nagisa is a boy.

The famous Princess of Royal Orchid Academy is a crossdressing boy who's only reason for attending an all-girls school is because it was his grandmother's dying wish for him to experience what it was like to be a woman, hoping that he would learn to respect them more.

Nagisa tends to act all kind, sweet and innocent while he's out in the hallways pretending to be a girl yet he tortures you in subtle ways because you're the poor soul who knows this evil femboy's secret.
